definition_zh: adj. 自负的，自大的
definition_en: too proud of your own abilities or looks
core_image: 有人对着镜子整理头发，把别人都当观众
scene: 他一开口就自夸，旁人都听不下去。He is so conceited that he talks only about his own success.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：conceited 指自负的；句意是他一开口就自夸，旁人都听不下去。

senses.title: Too proud of oneself
senses.definition: having too high an opinion of your own worth
senses.definitionCN: 对自己的价值评价过高
senses.example: He is too conceited to take advice.
senses.exampleCN: 他太自负，听不进建议。
senses.why: Italian concetto meant a fancy notion.
senses.whyCN: 意大利语 concetto 意为奇想。

senses.title: Vain about appearance
senses.definition: overly pleased with how you look or seem
senses.definitionCN: 对自己外表或形象过分满意
senses.example: She was conceited about her new coat.
senses.exampleCN: 她对自己的新外套很自得。
senses.why: The sense grew from self-flattery.
senses.whyCN: 该义由自我奉承发展而来。

intro.en: Conceited began as a word about fanciful notions, then turned to self-image.
intro.cn: conceited 起初指奇思妙想，后来转向自我形象。

items.en: Concipere means to take in or conceive.
items.cn: concipere 意为领会、构想。

items.en: Concetto means a fancy notion.
items.cn: concetto 意为奇想。

items.en: Conceit named a clever image.
items.cn: 十六世纪 conceit 指巧妙的意象。

items.en: Conceited came to mean self-flattering.
items.cn: 十七世纪 conceited 转为自我吹捧。

items.en: It is now a plain criticism.
items.cn: 现代它是直白的贬评。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the conceit shape; the near-meaning group names pride.
note.cn: 形近组共享 conceit 词形；近义组列出骄傲。

normalIntro.en: A conceited person is in love with their own image.
normalIntro.cn: conceited 的人迷恋自己的形象。

normal.en: Conceit is the noun.
normal.cn: conceit 是名词。

normal.en: Conceited adds -ed.
normal.cn: conceited 加了 -ed。

normal.en: Conceited means too proud.
normal.cn: conceited 意为过于自负。

normal.en: A conceited smile says look at me.
normal.cn: 自大的微笑仿佛在说看我。

normal.en: Modest is the opposite.
normal.cn: modest 是它的反面。

abstract.en: A mirror polished all day.
abstract.cn: 整天擦拭的镜子。

abstract.en: A photo turned to face the room.
abstract.cn: 转向房间的照片。

abstract.en: A voice that only says I.
abstract.cn: 只会说我的一把声音。

examples.en: Nobody likes a conceited winner.
examples.cn: 没人喜欢自负的赢家。

examples.en: He sounded conceited in the interview.
examples.cn: 他在采访中听起来很自大。

examples.en: She is confident, not conceited.
examples.cn: 她是自信，而非自负。

dict_mnemonic.text: conceit（自负）+ -ed（具有）→ 满脑子自负的，即自大的。

root: 拉丁 concipere（领会）→ 意大利语 concetto（奇想）→ conceit → 英语 conceited

sensesIntro.en: Too high an opinion of yourself, and of how you look.
sensesIntro.cn: 对自己、对自身形象的评价都过高。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: someone checking a mirror while ignoring the room
core.cn: 核心意象：对着镜子而忽略全屋的人

branches.en: A winner who takes all the credit.
branches.cn: 揽尽功劳的赢家。

branches.en: A voice that cannot hear advice.
branches.cn: 听不进建议的声音。

branches.en: A coat shown off at every door.
branches.cn: 逢门就炫耀的外套。

branches.en: A pose held for photographs.
branches.cn: 拍照时保持的姿势。

branches.en: Pride in self and in surface.
branches.cn: 对自我与表象的骄傲。

intro.en: Conceited is built from conceiving pieces; the list adds pride words.
intro.cn: conceited 由「构想」词素构成；下面列出骄傲词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin capere is to take, concipere is to take in, and arrogare is to claim.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 capere 意为拿取，concipere 意为领会，arrogare 意为声称。

latinEntries.exampleCN: concipere 产生 conceit 与 conceive。
capere 产生 capture 与 receive。
arrogare 产生 arrogant 与 arrogance。

definition_zh: 构想；设想；理解；认为；怀孕
definition_en: to form an idea or plan in the mind; to become pregnant; to understand
core_image: 灯下图纸上先出现一个只有轮廓的圆
scene: 设计会上没人说话，她在纸上画出一个谁也想不到的结构。She conceived a bridge that could be built without closing the road.
sceneCN: 这里指在脑中形成新的方案（第 1 个义项：构想、构思）；句意是她构想出一座不用封路就能建的桥。

pos.zh: 构想；设想；理解；认为；怀孕

senses.title: To form a new idea or plan
senses.definition: to bring a new idea or design into the mind
senses.definitionCN: 在脑中形成新的想法或设计
senses.example: She conceived a bridge that could be built without closing the road.
senses.exampleCN: 她构想出一座不用封路就能建的桥。
senses.why: Latin concipere meant to take in, and the mind was seen as receiving and holding a seed of an idea.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 concipere 意为「纳入」，心智被看作接受并孕育一粒想法的种子。

senses.title: To imagine a possibility
senses.definition: to picture something that might exist or happen
senses.definitionCN: 想象可能存在或发生的事物
senses.example: I cannot conceive of a city without a river.
senses.exampleCN: 我无法想象一座没有河的城市。
senses.why: The word allows the mind to hold what the senses have never met.
senses.whyCN: 这个词让心智握住感官从未遇见的东西。

senses.title: To understand
senses.definition: to grasp the meaning of something
senses.definitionCN: 把握某事物的意义
senses.example: He could not conceive how the trick was done.
senses.exampleCN: 他无法理解这个戏法是怎么做的。
senses.why: To take something in is also to understand it, and the two senses share the same image.
senses.whyCN: 把某物「纳进来」也就是理解它，两义共享同一意象。

senses.title: To become pregnant
senses.definition: to become pregnant
senses.definitionCN: 怀上孩子
senses.example: She conceived in the spring.
senses.exampleCN: 她在春天怀孕了。
senses.why: The oldest sense is biological: to take in and begin a new life.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义是生物学的：纳入并开始新的生命。

senses.title: To regard something as
senses.definition: to think of something in a particular way
senses.definitionCN: 以某种方式看待某事物
senses.example: The plan was conceived as a temporary measure.
senses.exampleCN: 这个方案最初被设想为临时措施。
senses.why: A thing is conceived in the shape the mind gives it at the start.
senses.whyCN: 事物在开端时，被构想成心智给它的那个形状。

senses.title: A work is conceived in a certain way
senses.titleCN: 作品以某种方式被构思
senses.definition: to have a work planned or imagined in a stated form
senses.definitionCN: 以所述形式规划或想象一部作品
senses.example: The novel was conceived as three separate voices.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说被构思成三个各自独立的声音。
senses.why: Artists speak of conception before execution, and the word marks that first holding.
senses.whyCN: 艺术家在动笔前先谈构思，这个词标出最初的握有。

senses.title: To devise a scheme
senses.definition: to invent a plan, often a secret or clever one
senses.definitionCN: 发明一个计划，常指隐秘或机巧的
senses.example: The pair conceived a scheme to avoid the tax.
senses.exampleCN: 这两个人策划了一个避税方案。
senses.why: The neutral act of forming a plan takes a darker colour when the plan is hidden.
senses.whyCN: 构思本是中性行为，计划一旦隐秘，就染上更暗的颜色。

senses.title: To hold an opinion
senses.definition: to think or believe something, in formal use
senses.definitionCN: 以正式语体表示思考或相信
senses.example: The author conceived of the soul as a kind of music.
senses.exampleCN: 作者把灵魂看作一种音乐。
senses.why: Formal writing keeps the old sense of taking a view into the mind.
senses.whyCN: 正式写作保留「把一种看法纳入心中」的旧义。

intro.en: Conceive comes from Latin concipere, to take in or receive, from com- together plus capere, to take. The direct source and both elements are clear.
intro.cn: conceive 来自拉丁 concipere「纳入、接受」，由 com-「一起」与 capere「拿取」构成。直接来源与两个构件都清楚。

items.en: Capere meant to take or seize, and it is the source of capture, accept and receive as well.
items.cn: capere 意为拿取、抓住，也是 capture、accept 与 receive 的来源。

items.en: Concipere joined com- with capere and meant to take in, to hold within, and to become pregnant.
items.cn: concipere 把 com- 与 capere 结合，意为纳入、容纳、受孕。

items.en: Latin and later European writers used the same verb for an idea held in the mind, as if thought were conceived.
items.cn: 拉丁及后来欧洲的写作者用同一个动词指心中怀有的想法，仿佛思想也被孕育。

items.en: Old French conceveir brought the verb into English.
items.cn: 古法语 conceveir 把这个动词带进英语。

items.en: Conceive appears in the late Middle Ages; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: conceive 在中世纪晚期出现，确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Concept, conception and inception all come from the same taking-in verb.
items.cn: concept、conception 与 inception 都出自同一个「纳入」动词。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin take-in stem; the second group names forming, imagining and understanding.
note.cn: 第一组共享拉丁语「纳入」词干；第二组是形成、想象与理解的近义说法。

entries.definition: The act of forming an idea, or the beginning of pregnancy.
entries.definitionCN: 形成想法的行为，或怀孕的开始。

entries.definition: Able to be imagined or believed.
An idea taken into the mind and held.
entries.definitionCN: 被纳入心中并持守的观念。

entries.definition: To mislead; from decipere, to catch by a trick, with a different prefix.
entries.definitionCN: 误导；出自 decipere「以计捕获」，前缀不同。

entries.definition: To form a picture in the mind.
To work out a plan or method.
To picture a future state clearly.
To grasp the meaning of something.
To plan the form of something before making it.
entries.definitionCN: 在制作前规划某物的形态。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin taking-in verb, the real family and real collocations.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁「纳入」动词、真实同族词与真实搭配。

normal.en: Concipere is to take in, and the mind takes in an idea as a body takes in a new life.
normal.cn: concipere 是纳入，心智纳入想法，正如身体纳入新生命。

normal.en: Concept and conception come from the same verb; deceive has a different prefix.
normal.cn: concept 与 conception 出自同一动词；deceive 前缀不同。

normal.en: The phrase with of is used for imagining what does not exist yet.
normal.cn: 后面带介词的说法用于想象尚未存在之物。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the use: conceive a plan, conceive a child, hard to conceive.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：构想方案、怀孕、难以想象。

normal.en: Conceivable and inconceivable are the two adjective poles.
normal.cn: conceivable 与 inconceivable 是两个形容词极端。

abstract.en: Conceive is a lamp over blank paper where a shape first appears as an outline.
abstract.cn: 构想是灯下白纸上先浮出一个轮廓。

abstract.en: The word holds two kinds of beginning in one: an idea and a life.
abstract.cn: 这个词同时握住两种开端：一个想法与一条生命。

abstract.en: To understand is to let a meaning inside, not merely to look at it.
abstract.cn: 理解是让意义进来，而不只是看着它。

examples.en: The architect conceived the house as a single open room.
examples.cn: 建筑师把这栋房子构想成一个开放的单间。

examples.en: Few could conceive of a winter without snow here.
examples.cn: 这里的人很难想象一个不下雪的冬天。

examples.en: The plan was conceived in secret and announced at the end.
examples.cn: 这个计划在暗中构思，最后才公布。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「肯吸物」——把想法吸进脑子里：构想

root: 拉丁 concipere「纳入、接受、受孕」← com-「一起」+ capere「拿取」。capere 也是 capture、accept、receive 的来源；同族 concept、conception、inception 都出同一动词，deceive 则出自 decipere，前缀不同。古法语 conceveir 传入英语，中世纪晚期出现，确切首见年代不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses hold idea, possibility, understanding, pregnancy, regard, artistic conception, scheme and formal opinion.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项分别握住想法、可能性、理解、怀孕、看待、艺术构思、计谋与正式看法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lamp over blank paper where a shape first appears as an outline.
core.cn: 核心意象：灯下白纸上，一个形状先以轮廓浮现。

branches.en: THE FORMED IDEA: a plan brought into being and a work shaped at conception.
branches.cn: 形成的想法：被带入存在的方案与在构思时定形的作品。

branches.en: THE IMAGINED POSSIBILITY: what might exist and the scheme devised in secret.
branches.cn: 想象的可能：可能存在之物与暗中策划的计谋。

branches.en: THE UNDERSTOOD MEANING: grasping how something works and holding a formal view.
branches.cn: 被理解的意义：把握事物如何运作，以及持有正式看法。

branches.en: THE BIOLOGICAL BEGINNING: new life taken in.
branches.cn: 生物学的开端：新生命被纳入。

branches.en: THE ASSIGNED SHAPE: a thing regarded in a stated way.
branches.cn: 被赋予的形状：以所述方式看待的事物。

intro.en: Conceive is the Latin taking-in verb with English noun and adjective forms; capere is the core.
intro.cn: conceive 是拉丁「纳入」动词加英语名词与形容词形式；capere 是核心。

latinIntro.en: Capere supplies the taking, com- supplies the inward direction, and conceptio supplies the noun.
latinIntro.cn: capere 提供「拿取」，com- 提供向内的方向，conceptio 提供名词。

items.example: The prefix turns taking into taking in.
The verb is the core of capture and accept as well.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词也是 capture 与 accept 的核心。

items.structure: Latin verb from com- and capere
items.example: The compound carries both the mental and the biological sense.
items.exampleCN: 复合词兼有心理与生物两义。

items.example: The held idea becomes a noun of its own.
items.exampleCN: 被握有的想法独立成名词。

items.meaning: to form in the mind; to become pregnant
items.example: English keeps both the mental and the bodily senses.
items.exampleCN: 英语同时保留心理与身体两义。

items.meaning: the act of forming or beginning
items.example: The noun covers idea and pregnancy alike.
The suffix -able marks what the mind can hold.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -able 标记心智握得住的东西。

items.example: The negative prefix refuses the holding.
items.exampleCN: 否定前缀拒绝这种握有。

items.example: It also builds achievable, visible and readable.
items.exampleCN: 它也构成 achievable、visible 与 readable。

definition_zh: 集中；专心；聚集；浓缩物
definition_en: to give all your attention to one thing, or to make something stronger by removing water
core_image: 一束散开的光被透镜收成一个亮点
scene: 图书馆里，她把手机翻面扣在桌上才开始读书。He turned off the music so he could concentrate on the chapter.
sceneCN: 这里 concentrate 指「集中注意力」（第 1 个义项：把心思放在一件事上）；句意是他关掉音乐，好把注意力集中在这一章上。

senses.title: Focus your attention
senses.definition: to give all your attention to one thing
senses.definitionCN: 把全部注意力放在一件事上
senses.example: She concentrated on the map.
senses.exampleCN: 她专心看地图。
senses.why: The mind scatters easily, so it must be gathered onto one point.
senses.whyCN: 心思容易散开，所以必须收拢到一个点上。

senses.title: Bring together in one place
senses.definition: to bring things or people together in one place
senses.definitionCN: 把事物或人聚到一个地方
senses.example: The troops were concentrated near the border.
senses.exampleCN: 部队集中在边境附近。
senses.why: The same gathering motion works for armies and for attention.
senses.whyCN: 这种收拢的动作既能用于军队，也能用于注意力。

senses.title: Make stronger by removing water
senses.definition: to make a liquid stronger by taking water out of it
senses.definitionCN: 去掉水分使液体更浓
senses.example: The juice is concentrated before shipping.
senses.exampleCN: 果汁在运输前先被浓缩。
senses.why: Less water means the same substance sits in a smaller space.
senses.whyCN: 水分少了，同样的物质就集中在更小的空间里。

intro.en: Concentrate is built from Latin com-, together, and centrum, the centre: to bring to one centre.
intro.cn: concentrate 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 centrum（中心）构成，意为聚到一个中心。

items.en: Centrum meant the middle point of a circle.
items.cn: centrum 指圆的中心点。

items.en: Concentrare meant to bring several things to one centre.
items.cn: concentrare 意为把几样东西聚到一个中心。

items.en: French concentrer applied the word to liquids and to thought.
items.cn: 法语 concentrer 把它同时用于液体与思想。

items.en: English concentrate first meant to bring to a common centre.
items.cn: 英语 concentrate 最初指聚到共同的中心。

items.en: It now covers attention, troops and strong liquids.
items.cn: 如今它覆盖注意力、部队与浓液体。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to concentrate, and the meaning group names other words for gathering or focusing.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 concentrate 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示聚集与聚焦的词。

entries.definition: strong because water has been removed
to give attention to one thing
to bring people or things together
to make something thicker or shorter

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with light through a lens, then move to troops in one place and to strong juice.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从穿过透镜的光开始，再走到聚集一处的部队与浓果汁。

normal.en: Con- is together and centre is the middle, so concentrate is to bring everything to the middle.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，centre 是中心，concentrate 就是把一切收拢到中心。

normal.en: A lens concentrates light into one bright point.
normal.cn: 透镜把光集中成一个亮点。

normal.en: Concentrate on one page and the other pages go quiet.
normal.cn: 专心看一页，其他页就安静下来。

normal.en: Concentrated juice has less water and more taste.
normal.cn: 浓缩果汁水分更少，味道更足。

normal.en: The noun concentration covers both attention and strength of a mixture.
normal.cn: 名词 concentration 同时覆盖注意力与混合物的浓度。

abstract.en: Picture a magnifying glass burning a small dot on paper.
abstract.cn: 想象放大镜在纸上烧出一个小点。

abstract.en: Picture many roads all ending at one square.
abstract.cn: 想象许多条路都通向同一个广场。

abstract.en: Picture a wide river squeezed into a narrow channel.
abstract.cn: 想象一条宽河被收进窄窄的河道。

examples.en: It is hard to concentrate in a noisy room.
examples.cn: 在吵闹的房间里很难集中注意力。

examples.en: The general concentrated his forces near the river.
examples.cn: 将军把兵力集中在河边。

examples.en: The factory concentrates the milk before packing it.
examples.cn: 工厂先把牛奶浓缩再包装。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 concentrate 记成 con（一起）加 centre（中心）：把力气和心思一起收到中心，就是集中、专心。

root: 源自拉丁语 com（一起）与 centrum（中心），本义是聚到一个中心，后引申为集中注意力、聚集力量与浓缩液体。

sensesIntro.en: From many rays meeting at one point, to many people in one place, and finally to less water in the same liquid.
sensesIntro.cn: 从许多光线汇于一点，到许多人聚于一处，最后到同样液体里更少的水。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lens drawing scattered light into one bright point.
core.cn: 核心意象：透镜把散开的光收成一个亮点。

branches.en: Attention is the most common everyday sense.
branches.cn: 注意力是最常见的日常义项。

branches.en: Bringing people or troops together is the physical version.
branches.cn: 把人员或部队聚到一起是它的具体版本。

branches.en: Removing water concentrates a liquid in the same pattern.
branches.cn: 去掉水分以同样的方式浓缩液体。

branches.en: Mind and army both gain force by gathering.
branches.cn: 心思与军队都因收拢而增强力量。

branches.en: Both senses make one place or one liquid hold more.
branches.cn: 两个义项都让一个地方或一种液体装得更多。

intro.en: Concentrate is built on Latin com-, together, plus centrum, centre, with the verb ending -ate.
intro.cn: concentrate 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、centrum（中心）与动词词尾 -ate 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin centre base also gives central, eccentric and concentric.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的中心的词基还给出 central、eccentric 与 concentric。

items.example: The plant concentrates the ore first.
He sat concentrating on one page.

items.exampleCN: 这项任务需要全神贯注。

items.example: The concentrator removes water from the juice.
items.exampleCN: 浓缩器把果汁里的水去掉。

items.example: The work has a concentrative effect.
items.exampleCN: 这项工作有让人专注的作用。

items.example: Try to concentrate on the first question.
items.exampleCN: 试着把注意力放在第一个问题上。

definition_zh: 专注；集中；浓度；聚集
definition_en: the ability to focus your attention, or the amount of a substance in a mixture

senses.title: The power to focus
senses.definition: the ability to give all your attention to something
senses.definitionCN: 把全部注意力放在某事上的能力
senses.example: Reading in noise demands great concentration.
senses.exampleCN: 在噪声中阅读需要高度专注。
senses.why: The mind must hold one point and let the rest fade.
senses.whyCN: 心智必须守住一个点，让其余的都淡下去。

senses.title: A gathering in one place
senses.definition: the act of bringing many things together in one place
senses.definitionCN: 把许多东西聚到一处
senses.example: The concentration of factories in the valley worried residents.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂聚集在山谷里，让居民担忧。
senses.why: People and things can be gathered just as light is gathered.
senses.whyCN: 人和物都能像光一样被收拢。

senses.title: Strength of a mixture
senses.definition: the amount of a substance in a given amount of liquid or air
senses.definitionCN: 一定量液体或空气中所含某物质的量
senses.example: The concentration of salt in the water is low.
senses.exampleCN: 水中盐的浓度很低。
senses.why: How much is packed into a space is the scientific face of the same word.
senses.whyCN: 一个空间里装了多少，是这个词的科学一面。

items.en: Concentrare meant to bring things to one centre.

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a spotlight on one point, then move to crowded places and to strong mixtures.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从打在一个点上的聚光灯开始，再走到拥挤的地方与浓的混合物。

normal.en: Concentration is what a spotlight does: one point, all the light.

senses.title: A general idea
senses.definition: an idea of what something is or how it works
senses.definitionCN: 对某事物是什么或如何运作的想法
senses.example: The concept of time varies across cultures.
senses.exampleCN: 时间的概念在不同文化中有所不同。
senses.why: A concept gathers many examples under one name in the mind.
senses.whyCN: 概念在脑中把许多例子收在同一个名字下。

senses.title: A plan or design
senses.definition: an idea for a new product, plan or work
senses.definitionCN: 对新产品、计划或作品的设想
senses.example: The concept car was shown at the fair.
senses.exampleCN: 那辆概念车在展会上亮相。
senses.why: Before a thing exists, it exists as a picture in someone's mind.
senses.whyCN: 在事物存在之前，它先作为脑海中的画面存在。

intro.cn: concept 来自拉丁语 conceptum（被孕育之物），源自动词 concipere（纳入、孕育）。

items.en: Concipere joined com-, together, with capere, to take.
items.cn: concipere 由 com-（一起）与 capere（拿取）组合而成。

items.en: Conceptum named something taken into the mind.
items.cn: conceptum 指被收入心智的东西。

items.en: Conceptus described a thought formed inside a person.
items.cn: conceptus 描述在人内部形成的想法。

items.en: English concept named a general idea held in the mind.

items.en: It now also names the first design of a product.

a belief or idea, often vague

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with many examples tied into one knot, then move to a car that exists only as a drawing.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从许多例子被系成一个结开始，再走到只以图纸存在的汽车。

normal.en: Con- is together and cept is to take, so a concept is what the mind takes in together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，cept 是拿取，concept 就是心智一起收进来的东西。

normal.en: A concept is a box in the mind that holds many examples.
normal.cn: 概念是脑中的一只盒子，装着许多例子。

normal.en: Concept is the thing; conception is the act of forming it.
normal.cn: concept 是那个东西，conception 是形成它的动作。

normal.en: A concept car is a car that lives in the mind before the road.
normal.cn: 概念车是先活在脑中、后上路的汽车。

normal.en: Abstract concepts have no shape, so we borrow pictures for them.

abstract.en: Picture a light bulb above a sketched machine.
abstract.cn: 想象一台草图机器上方亮起一只灯泡。

abstract.en: Picture a label that fits a whole shelf of jars.
abstract.cn: 想象一张标签适合整架罐子。

examples.en: Children learn the concept of number before they write figures.
examples.cn: 孩子在写数字之前先学会数的概念。

examples.en: The designer explained her concept for the new library.
examples.cn: 设计师讲解了她对新图书馆的构想。

examples.en: It is a simple concept but hard to apply.
examples.cn: 这是个简单的概念，却很难应用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 concept 记成 con（一起）加 cept（拿取）：把许多例子一起收进脑子，就成了一个概念。

sensesIntro.cn: 从把例子收拢起来的一般想法，到先于实物存在的设计。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one thin line tying many scattered examples into a single knot.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条细线把许多散开的例子系成一个结。

branches.en: The general idea is the central and most common sense.
branches.cn: 一般想法是核心也最常见的义项。

branches.en: The design sense narrows the idea to a future product.
branches.cn: 设计义项把想法收窄到未来的产品。

branches.en: Philosophers study concepts as units of thought.
branches.cn: 哲学家把概念当作思维单位来研究。

branches.en: Companies show concept models before they sell anything.
branches.cn: 公司在销售之前先展示概念模型。

branches.en: Both senses are things held in the mind before they are things in the world.
branches.cn: 两个义项都是先存在于脑中、后存在于世上的东西。

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的拿取词基 cap- 还给出 capture、accept 与 capacity。

core_image: 一粒种子落进土里，同时另一颗念头在心里落定，两者都叫“开始成形”
scene: 他对「公平」的理解与同事完全不同。His conception of fairness is nothing like his colleague's, so the same proposal reads as two different things.

senses.title: Biological conception
senses.definition: the moment when an egg is fertilised and a pregnancy begins
senses.definitionCN: 卵子受精、妊娠开始的时刻
senses.example: The drug can prevent conception.
senses.exampleCN: 该药可阻止受孕。
senses.why: Medicine uses the word for a physical beginning. The Latin image of 'taking in' fits: the egg takes in the sperm, and a new process starts. This sense is concrete and dated, unlike the mental ones.
senses.whyCN: 医学用该词指物理开端。拉丁“摄入”意象正合：卵摄入精子，新过程开始。此义具体、可定日期，不同于心智诸义。

senses.title: Forming a plan
senses.definition: the act of forming an idea or plan in the mind
senses.definitionCN: 在心中形成想法或计划的行为
senses.example: The conception of the reform took years.
senses.exampleCN: 这项改革的构想用了数年。
senses.why: Here the word names the act, not the idea produced. A conception is an event in someone's mind; a concept is the content that can be shared afterwards.
senses.whyCN: 此处该词命名动作，而非产出的观念。conception 是某人心中发生的事件；concept 是此后可共享的内容。

senses.title: A way of understanding
senses.definition: the particular way a person or group understands something
senses.definitionCN: 个人或群体理解某事物的特定方式
senses.example: Different cultures have different conceptions of time.
senses.exampleCN: 不同文化有不同的时间观。
senses.why: This is the dominant modern sense: conception is perspectival. Two people can share the word 'justice' and still have incompatible conceptions of it, which is why the noun is often paired with 'of'.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代主导义：conception 是视角性的。两人可共享“正义”一词，却对其有不相容的观念，故该名词常与 of 连用。

senses.title: A conception of liberty
senses.definition: a systematic view of what a value means and requires
senses.definitionCN: 关于某价值意味着什么、要求什么的系统看法
senses.example: Berlin contrasted two conceptions of liberty.
senses.exampleCN: 伯林对比了两种自由观。
senses.why: Political theory uses the noun for rival interpretations of a shared value. The debate is not whether liberty is good but what counts as liberty, and each conception draws a different boundary.
senses.whyCN: 政治理论用该名词指对共享价值的不同解释。争论不是自由好不好，而是什么算自由；每种观念画出不同边界。

senses.title: The Immaculate Conception
senses.definition: the doctrine that Mary was conceived without original sin
senses.definitionCN: 玛利亚无原罪而成胎的教义
senses.example: The Immaculate Conception is a Marian doctrine.
senses.exampleCN: 无原罪成胎是关于玛利亚的教义。
senses.why: Theology fixes a capitalised phrase. Note the common confusion with the virgin birth: the Immaculate Conception concerns Mary's own conception, not the conception of Jesus.
senses.whyCN: 神学固定这一大写短语。注意常与童贞受孕混淆：无原罪成胎讲的是玛利亚自身的受孕，而非耶稣的受孕。

senses.title: Concept formation
senses.definition: the mental process by which a child or learner forms categories
senses.definitionCN: 儿童或学习者形成范畴的心智过程
senses.example: Piaget studied the child's conception of number.
senses.exampleCN: 皮亚杰研究儿童的数字概念形成。
senses.why: Psychology uses the noun for a developmental achievement. The child moves from particulars to a category, and the timing of that move is what experiments try to measure.
senses.whyCN: 心理学用该名词指发展成就。儿童从个别走向范畴，实验试图测量这一转变的时点。

senses.title: Artistic conception
senses.definition: the original idea and design of a work before or during its making
senses.definitionCN: 作品在制作前或制作中的原初想法与设计
senses.example: The painting's conception is bolder than its execution.
senses.exampleCN: 这幅画的构思比执行更大胆。
senses.why: Art criticism separates conception from execution: what was imagined versus what was made. A work can have a strong conception and a weak finish, or the reverse.
senses.whyCN: 艺术批评区分构思与执行：想象之物与制成之物。作品可构思强而完成弱，或反之。

senses.title: The beginning of something
senses.definition: the point at which an enterprise or process is first conceived
senses.definitionCN: 事业或过程最初被构想的时点
senses.example: The conception of the project dates to 2019.
senses.exampleCN: 该项目肇始于二〇一九年。
senses.why: This sense extends 'conception' from a mind to a project's origin. The plan is treated as an entity with a birth, and the word gives it a biography.
senses.whyCN: 此义把 conception 从心智扩展到项目的起源。计划被当作有出生的实体，该词给它一部传记。

senses.title: A world conception
senses.definition: an organized set of beliefs about reality and value
senses.definitionCN: 关于实在与价值的组织化信念集合
senses.example: Marx's conception of history shaped the century.
senses.exampleCN: 马克思的历史观塑造了那个世纪。
senses.why: Philosophy uses the noun for a comprehensive outlook. A world conception is more than one idea; it is a system in which the ideas support one another.
senses.whyCN: 哲学用该名词指综合视野。世界观不止一个观念；它是一个观念相互支撑的系统。

intro.en: Conception is from Latin conceptio, the action noun of concipere 'to take in, receive, conceive', com- 'together' plus capere 'take'. The base is the same as concept and conceptual, but the suffix -ion names the act or process, while concept names the thing conceived. English uses conception for both biological fertilisation and mental formation, because Latin conceptio covered both: a taking in of seed or of an idea.
intro.cn: conception 出自拉丁 conceptio，即 concipere“摄入、接受、构想”的动作名词，由 com-“一起”加 capere“拿”构成。词基与 concept、conceptual 相同，但 -ion 后缀命名动作或过程，concept 则命名被构想之物。英语用 conception 兼指生物学受精与心智形成，因为拉丁 conceptio 两者都覆盖：摄入种子或摄入观念。

items.en: capere 'to take' and concipere 'to take in' are the base; the same root gives concept and capture.
items.cn: capere“拿”与 concipere“摄入”是词基；同根给出 concept 与 capture。

items.en: conceptio is the action noun: a taking in, a conceiving, whether of seed or of an idea.
items.cn: conceptio 是动作名词：摄入、构想，无论种子还是观念。

items.en: The word covered both biological and mental conception from the start, a double life English inherits.
items.cn: 该词从一开始就兼指生物受孕与心智构想，英语继承了这双重身份。

items.en: English conception enters in the 14C in theology and medicine, then spreads to philosophy.
items.cn: 英语 conception 于十四世纪进入神学与医学，后扩展到哲学。

items.en: The sense 'a way of understanding' becomes central in philosophical writing about ideas.
items.cn: 十七世纪“理解方式”义在论观念的哲学写作中成为核心。

items.en: Psychology, art criticism, and political theory each keep a specialised sense of the noun.
items.cn: 现代心理学、艺术批评与政治理论各保留该名词一个专门义。

note.en: The first group is the conceive family, where conception and concept divide act from product; the second is words for ideas, which differ in whether they name the act, the content, or a mistaken content.
note.cn: 第一组是 conceive 词族，conception 与 concept 在此分工为动作与产品；第二组是“观念”类词，差别在于指动作、内容还是错误内容。

entries.definition: a thought or notion, often less systematic than a conception.

entries.definition: a vague or general idea, often informal or slightly dismissive.

entries.definition: a particular reading or explanation of something. It stresses reading a text or event.

normal.en: Concipere is 'take in'. Conception is the taking-in; concept is what has been taken in.
normal.cn: concipere 是“摄入”。conception 是摄入动作；concept 是被摄入之物。

normal.en: The same word covers seed and idea because Latin conceptio did: both are beginnings that take hold.
normal.cn: 同一个词覆盖种子与观念，因为拉丁 conceptio 如此：两者都是落定的开端。

normal.en: Conception of X is how you understand X; a concept of X is the content you can share. Perspective versus package.
normal.cn: conception of X 是你如何理解 X；concept of X 是可共享的内容。视角对包裹。

normal.en: The Immaculate Conception is about Mary's own conception, not Jesus's virgin birth; the two doctrines are often confused.
normal.cn: 无原罪成胎讲玛利亚自身的受孕，不是耶稣的童贞降生；两种教义常被混淆。

normal.en: 'The conception of the project' gives a plan a birth date; the metaphor turns an idea into a biography.
normal.cn: the conception of the project 给计划一个出生日；隐喻把观念变成传记。

abstract.en: Conception is the act that makes a concept possible; without the act, there is no content to share.
abstract.cn: conception 是使概念成为可能的动作；没有动作，就没有可共享的内容。

abstract.en: Rival conceptions of one value cannot be settled by definition alone, because each conception is a whole way of seeing.
abstract.cn: 对同一价值的不同观念不能只靠定义解决，因为每种观念都是一整套看的方式。

abstract.en: Every beginning is a conception in retrospect: the origin is assigned after the fact, not given with it.
abstract.cn: 每个开端都是回溯中的构想：起源是事后指派的，而非与生俱来的。

examples.en: The conception of the new library began with a public meeting.
examples.cn: 新图书馆的构想始于一次公开会议。

examples.en: Children's conceptions of distance differ from adults'.
examples.cn: 儿童对距离的概念与成人不同。

examples.en: The study covers the period from conception to birth.
examples.cn: 该研究涵盖从受孕到出生这一时期。

dict_mnemonic.text: “康塞普申”——心里“接住”一个念头，或身体接住一粒种子 → conception 构想/受孕

root: 拉丁 conceptio（concipere“摄入、构想”的动作名词 = com-“一起”+ capere“拿”）；与 concept、conceptual 同根。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of conception: fertilisation, plan-forming, a way of understanding, a political view of a value, a Marian doctrine, concept formation, artistic design, a project's origin, and a world view. The thread is a beginning that takes hold, in body or mind.
sensesIntro.cn: conception 的九个义项：受孕、构想计划、理解方式、价值之政治观、玛利亚教义、概念形成、艺术构思、项目肇始、世界观。共同线索是身体或心智中落定的开端。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a seed falling into soil and an idea settling in a mind, both beginning to take form.
core.cn: 核心意象：一粒种子落入土中，一个念头落入心中，两者都开始成形。

branches.en: THE BODY AND THE CHILD: fertilisation and concept formation are beginnings that develop.
branches.cn: 身体与儿童：受精与概念形成都是会发展的开端。

branches.en: THE ACT AND THE WORK: planning, artistic design, and a project's origin are conceptions in time.
branches.cn: 动作与作品：计划、艺术构思与项目肇始都是时间中的构想。

branches.en: THE OUTLOOK: political conceptions and world views are organized perspectives.
branches.cn: 视野：政治观念与世界观都是组织化的视角。

branches.en: THE DOCTRINE: the Immaculate Conception fixes a theological sense and a common confusion.
branches.cn: 教义：无原罪成胎固定一个神学义与一种常见混淆。

branches.en: THE CONTRAST: conception is perspectival where concept is shareable content.
branches.cn: 对照：conception 是视角性的，concept 是可共享内容。

intro.en: Conception is conceive + -ion, from Latin conceptio. Conceive is concipere, com- plus capere 'take'. The family includes concept, conceptual, conceptional, and misconception; the same capere root gives capture and captive.
intro.cn: conception 是 conceive 加 -ion，出自拉丁 conceptio。conceive 是 concipere（com- 加 capere“拿”）。词族含 concept、conceptual、conceptional、misconception；同一 capere 词根给出 capture 与 captive。

latinIntro.en: Latin concipere 'take in, conceive' gives conceptio 'a conceiving'. English keeps -ion for the act and uses concept for the product. The -ual adjective conceptual belongs to concept, while conceptional belongs to conception, a useful division.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 concipere“摄入、构想”给出 conceptio“构想”。英语保留 -ion 指动作，用 concept 指产品。-ual 形容词 conceptual 属于 concept，而 conceptional 属于 conception，这是有用的分工。

items.meaning: the act of conceiving; a way of understanding
items.meaningCN: 构想；受孕；观念（-ion 名词）
构想的；受孕的（-al 形容词）
误解；错误观念（mis- 前缀）

definition_zh: 概念上的；观念的；概念性的；概念模型的；概念设计的；概念艺术的
definition_en: relating to concepts or mental ideas rather than to physical things or practical details
core_image: 一张画在纸上的思维草图，还没有变成实物，却已决定实物该长什么样
scene: 这个方案的早期阶段已经完成，只有框图和定义，还没有一块真正的材料。The conceptual stage of the plan is finished: there are diagrams and definitions, but not one piece of real material.
sceneCN: 这里 conceptual 是「概念阶段的、概念上的」（第 1 个义项：与概念有关，而非与实物或细节有关）；句意：这个方案的概念阶段已完成：只有框图和定义，还没有一块真正的材料。图中可辨识物件：思维导图、框图、未组装的零件、草图、标注箭头。

pos.zh: 概念上的；观念的；概念性的

senses.title: Relating to concepts
senses.titleCN: 概念上的；与概念有关的
senses.definition: concerned with ideas or general notions rather than with instances
senses.definitionCN: 关乎观念或一般概念，而非具体实例
senses.example: The paper offers a conceptual analysis of rights.
senses.exampleCN: 论文对权利作了概念分析。
senses.why: This is the defining sense: it marks a level of abstraction. A conceptual question asks what a term means or how ideas relate, not what happens in a particular case.
senses.whyCN: 这是定义性义：它标记抽象层级。概念问题问的是术语何意、观念如何关联，而非某具体案例发生了什么。

senses.title: Abstract rather than practical
senses.definition: existing as an idea rather than as a physical or practical reality
senses.definitionCN: 作为观念而非物理或实践现实存在
senses.example: The plan is still conceptual.
senses.exampleCN: 该计划仍停留在概念层面。
senses.why: Here the adjective is a stage marker: nothing has been built. It can be neutral (early design) or critical (all talk, no implementation), depending on tone and context.
senses.whyCN: 此处形容词是阶段标记：尚未建成。它可中性（早期设计），也可批评（全是空谈、未落地），取决于语气与语境。

senses.title: Conceptual art
senses.definition: art in which the idea or concept matters more than the finished object
senses.definitionCN: 观念或概念比成品更重要的艺术
senses.example: Conceptual art often exists mainly as text.
senses.exampleCN: 概念艺术常主要以文本存在。
senses.why: Art history turns the word into a movement: the artwork is the concept, and the object may be secondary or absent. This is the most radical case of 'idea before thing'.
senses.whyCN: 艺术史把该词变成一场运动：作品即概念，实物可以次要甚至缺席。这是“观念先于实物”最激进的例子。

senses.title: A conceptual model
senses.definition: a simplified representation of the ideas and relations in a system
senses.definitionCN: 对系统中观念与关系的简化表示
senses.example: The team drew a conceptual model before coding.
senses.exampleCN: 团队在编码前画了概念模型。
senses.why: Modelling uses the adjective for a map of meanings, not of measurements. A conceptual model says which entities and relations matter; a computational model then makes them precise.
senses.whyCN: 建模用该形容词指意义地图，而非测量地图。概念模型说明哪些实体与关系重要；计算模型随后把它们精确化。

senses.title: Conceptual design
senses.definition: the early phase of design in which the main idea and constraints are fixed
senses.definitionCN: 设计早期阶段，主要想法与约束在此确定
senses.example: Conceptual design precedes detailed engineering.
senses.exampleCN: 概念设计先于详细工程。
senses.why: Design practice separates phases. The conceptual phase decides what problem is being solved and what counts as a good solution; later phases decide dimensions and materials.
senses.whyCN: 设计实践区分阶段。概念阶段决定要解决什么问题、什么算好方案；后续阶段决定尺寸与材料。

senses.title: A conceptual framework
senses.definition: the set of concepts and assumptions used to organize a study or argument
senses.definitionCN: 用于组织研究或论证的概念与假设集合
senses.example: The study lacks a clear conceptual framework.
senses.exampleCN: 该研究缺少清晰的概念框架。
senses.why: Research methods use the phrase for the scaffolding of inquiry. The framework is not data; it is the grid through which data become visible as evidence.
senses.whyCN: 研究方法用该短语指探究的脚手架。框架不是数据；它是使数据显现为证据的网格。

senses.title: A conceptual problem
senses.definition: a difficulty in the meaning or logic of an idea rather than in its execution
senses.definitionCN: 出在观念的意义或逻辑、而非执行上的困难
senses.example: The proposal has a conceptual flaw.
senses.exampleCN: 该提案有概念上的缺陷。
senses.why: This sense diagnoses where a problem lives. A conceptual problem cannot be fixed by better engineering, because the categories themselves are wrong or inconsistent.
senses.whyCN: 此义诊断问题所在。概念问题不能靠更好的工程解决，因为范畴本身错误或不一致。

senses.title: Conceptual understanding
senses.definition: grasping the principles and relations of a subject, not just procedures
senses.definitionCN: 掌握学科的原理与关系，而不只是步骤
senses.example: Students need conceptual understanding, not only drills.
senses.exampleCN: 学生需要概念性理解，而不只是操练。
senses.why: Education uses the adjective to distinguish knowing why from knowing how. A student can perform a procedure and still lack conceptual understanding if they cannot explain why it works.
senses.whyCN: 教育用该形容词区分“知为何”与“知如何”。学生能执行步骤却讲不出为何有效，仍缺概念性理解。

senses.title: Conceptual vocabulary
senses.definition: the set of terms that name the ideas of a field
senses.definitionCN: 命名某领域观念的术语集合
senses.example: The glossary defines the conceptual vocabulary of the field.
senses.exampleCN: 术语表界定了该领域的概念词汇。
senses.why: This metalinguistic sense names the words that carry concepts. A field's conceptual vocabulary is its toolkit; disputes about terms are often disputes about the ideas themselves.
senses.whyCN: 这一元语言义命名承载概念的词。领域的概念词汇就是其工具箱；术语之争常是观念之争。

intro.en: Conceptual is concept plus -ual. Concept comes from Latin conceptus, 'a taking in, a conception', from concipere 'to take in, receive, conceive', itself com- 'together' plus capere 'to take, seize'. The suffix -ual is Latin -ualis, 'relating to'. So conceptual literally means 'relating to a concept'. Note the pair conceptual / conceptional: both exist, but conceptional usually belongs to conception, including biological conception, while conceptual belongs to concept, the idea.
intro.cn: conceptual 是 concept 加 -ual。concept 出自拉丁 conceptus“摄入、构想”，源于 concipere“摄入、接受、构想”，即 com-“一起”加 capere“拿、抓”。后缀 -ual 是拉丁 -ualis“与…有关的”。故 conceptual 字面即“与概念有关的”。注意 conceptual / conceptional 这一对：两者都存在，但 conceptional 通常属于 conception（包括生物学受孕），conceptual 属于 concept（观念）。

items.en: capere means 'to take, seize, grasp'; it gives capture, captive, and the -ceive verbs.
items.cn: capere 意为“拿、抓、握”，给出 capture、captive 与 -ceive 系列动词。

items.en: concipere is com- 'together' plus capere: to take in, receive, and hence to conceive an idea or a child.
items.cn: concipere 是 com-“一起”加 capere：摄入、接受，故构想观念或怀胎。

items.en: conceptus, its past participle, means 'conceived, a conception'; English concept keeps the mental thing, not the act.
items.cn: 其过去分词 conceptus 意为“被构想的、构想”；英语 concept 保留心智之物，而非动作。

items.en: conceptualis adds -ualis 'relating to' to conceptus; English -ual continues this suffix.
items.cn: conceptualis 在 conceptus 上加 -ualis“与…有关”；英语 -ual 延续该后缀。

items.en: Conceptual becomes common in philosophy and psychology for what belongs to ideas rather than things.
items.cn: 十九世纪 conceptual 在哲学与心理学中常见，指属于观念而非事物者。

items.en: Design, art, and education adopt it for early phases, idea-driven works, and understanding of principles.
items.cn: 二十世纪设计、艺术与教育采用它，指早期阶段、观念驱动作品与原理性理解。

note.en: The first group is the concept family; the second is adjectives of abstraction, which differ in whether they mean idea-level, theoretical, or merely not physical.
note.cn: 第一组是 concept 词族；第二组是抽象形容词，差别在于指观念层面、理论性还是仅非物理。

entries.definition: a general idea or category formed in the mind.
entries.definitionCN: 在心中形成的一般观念或范畴。

entries.definition: the act of forming an idea; also biological conception.
entries.definitionCN: 形成观念的动作；也指生物学受孕。

entries.definition: to form a concept of something.
based on theory rather than practice; it may still be testable.
entries.definitionCN: 基于理论而非实践；仍可被检验。

entries.definition: existing as an idea apart from particular things. It is broader and more philosophical.
entries.definitionCN: 作为脱离具体事物的观念存在。更广、更哲学。

entries.definition: existing only in thought or as a notion; often hypothetical.
entries.definitionCN: 仅存在于思想或观念中；常为假设的。

normalIntro.en: Real links: capere 'take', concipere 'take in', conceptus, and the -ual suffix meaning 'relating to'.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：capere“拿”、concipere“摄入”、conceptus，以及表“与…有关”的 -ual 后缀。

normal.en: Concept is what the mind has 'taken in' (con-cipere). Conceptual is the adjective of that taken-in idea.
normal.cn: concept 是心智“摄入”（con-cipere）之物。conceptual 是那被摄入观念的形容词。

normal.en: The -ual suffix means 'relating to', exactly as in manual, sensual, and conceptual.
normal.cn: -ual 后缀意为“与…有关”，正如 manual、sensual、conceptual。

normal.en: Conceptual and conceptional are not interchangeable: conceptional usually means 'of conception', including pregnancy.
normal.cn: conceptual 与 conceptional 不可互换：conceptional 通常指“受孕的、构想的”，包括怀孕。

normal.en: Conceptual art makes the idea the artwork; the object can be a receipt or a sentence.
normal.cn: 概念艺术把观念当作作品；实物可以是一张收据或一句话。

normal.en: A conceptual problem cannot be engineered away; the categories themselves are wrong.
normal.cn: 概念问题不能靠工程消除；范畴本身错了。

abstract.en: The conceptual level is where categories are chosen, and categories decide what can be seen as evidence afterwards.
abstract.cn: 概念层面是选择范畴之处，而范畴决定此后什么能作为证据被看见。

abstract.en: Calling a plan 'merely conceptual' can praise its clarity or dismiss its lack of reality; the adjective is a site of evaluation.
abstract.cn: 称计划“只是概念上的”，既可赞其清晰，也可贬其不实；该形容词是评价场。

abstract.en: Every discipline is held together by a conceptual vocabulary, and fights over words are fights over the world those words cut.
abstract.cn: 每个学科由概念词汇维系，词语之争即这些词所切割的世界之争。

examples.en: The proposal is still at the conceptual stage.
examples.cn: 该提案仍处于概念阶段。

examples.en: She has a strong conceptual understanding of physics.
examples.cn: 她对物理有很强的概念性理解。

examples.en: The gallery specialises in conceptual art.
examples.cn: 该画廊专营概念艺术。

dict_mnemonic.text: “康塞普秋尔”——先有 concept（概念），才有 conceptual（概念的）→ 概念上的

root: concept（拉丁 conceptus ← concipere“摄入、构想”= com-“一起”+ capere“拿”）+ -ual（拉丁 -ualis“与…有关”）。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of conceptual: relating to concepts, abstract rather than built, idea-driven art, a model of meanings, early design, a research framework, a flaw in categories, understanding of principles, and a field's term set. All mark the level of ideas.
sensesIntro.cn: conceptual 的九个义项：与概念有关、抽象未落地、观念艺术、意义模型、早期设计、研究框架、范畴缺陷、原理性理解、领域术语集。它们都标记观念层级。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a mind-map on paper that decides what the physical thing will later be.
core.cn: 核心意象：纸上的思维草图，决定实物此后该是什么样。

chain: JUDGE AT THE LEVEL OF IDEAS

branches.en: THE IDEA: analysis, flaw, and vocabulary all operate on concepts themselves.
branches.cn: 观念：分析、缺陷与词汇都作用于概念本身。

branches.en: THE ABSTRACTION: unbuilt plans and conceptual art put the idea before the object.
branches.cn: 抽象：未建的计划与概念艺术把观念放在实物之前。

branches.en: THE FRAMEWORK: models and research frameworks map which relations matter.
branches.cn: 框架：模型与研究框架勾画哪些关系重要。

branches.en: THE PHASE: conceptual design fixes the problem before dimensions are chosen.
branches.cn: 阶段：概念设计在选尺寸之前固定问题。

branches.en: THE LEARNING: understanding principles is knowing why, not only how.
branches.cn: 学习：理解原理是知为何，而不只是知如何。

intro.en: Conceptual is concept + -ual. Concept is Latin conceptus, from concipere, com- plus capere 'take'. The family includes conceptually, conceptualize, conceptualization, conception, and conceptional; the same capere root gives capture and captive.
intro.cn: conceptual 是 concept 加 -ual。concept 是拉丁 conceptus，出自 concipere（com- 加 capere“拿”）。词族含 conceptually、conceptualize、conceptualization、conception、conceptional；同一 capere 词根给出 capture 与 captive。

latinIntro.en: Latin capere 'take' gives concipere 'take in, conceive' and its participle conceptus. conceptus plus -ualis makes conceptualis, the source of conceptual. English also builds conception on conceptio and conceptualize on the adjective.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 capere“拿”给出 concipere“摄入、构想”及其分词 conceptus。conceptus 加 -ualis 成 conceptualis，即 conceptual 的来源。英语还在 conceptio 上造 conception，在形容词上造 conceptualize。

items.meaning: to form an idea; to become pregnant

definition_zh: 担忧；关心；涉及；关系；公司
definition_en: a feeling of worry, or something that affects or involves you
core_image: 母亲站在校门口，目光一直追着孩子的背影
scene: 医生看着检查单，眉头慢慢皱了起来。The results concern me, so I want more tests.
sceneCN: 这里 concern 指「使担忧」（第 2 个义项：让人感到不安）；句意是这些结果让我担心，所以我想再做几项检查。

pos.zh: 担忧；关心；关切的事；公司

collocations.phrase: as far as I am concerned

senses.title: A feeling of worry
senses.definition: a feeling of worry about something important
senses.definitionCN: 对重要事物的担忧之情
senses.example: There is growing concern about air quality.
senses.exampleCN: 人们对空气质量的担忧与日俱增。
senses.why: When something matters, the mind keeps returning to it with unease.
senses.whyCN: 当某件事重要时，心就会带着不安一再回到它身上。

senses.title: To make someone worried
senses.definition: to make someone feel worried or anxious
senses.definitionCN: 使某人感到担心或不安
senses.example: The test results concern the doctor.
senses.exampleCN: 检查结果让医生担忧。
senses.why: A fact can reach out and trouble the person who learns it.
senses.whyCN: 一个事实能伸出去，扰动得知它的人。

senses.title: To be about or affect
senses.definition: to affect someone, or to be about a particular subject
senses.definitionCN: 影响某人，或关于某个主题
senses.example: This decision concerns every employee.
senses.exampleCN: 这个决定涉及每一位员工。
senses.why: What touches you is what you must care about, so concern also means involvement.
senses.whyCN: 触动你的东西就是你必须在意的，所以 concern 也指关涉。

intro.en: Concern comes from Latin concernere, to sift together, from com-, together, and cernere, to sift or judge.
intro.cn: concern 来自拉丁语 concernere（一起筛），由 com-（一起）与 cernere（筛、判断）构成。

items.en: Cernere meant to sift, to separate or to judge.
items.cn: cernere 意为筛、分辨或判断。

items.en: Concernere meant to sift things together into one view.
items.cn: concernere 意为把东西筛到一起，纳入同一视野。

items.en: Old French concerner meant to relate to or to touch.
items.cn: 古法语 concerner 意为与…相关或触及。

items.en: English concern first meant to be relevant to something.
items.cn: 英语 concern 最初指与某事相关。

items.en: The sense of worry grew from things that are relevant and important.
items.cn: 担忧义从相关且重要的事情中生长出来。

entries.definition: to notice something that is not obvious
a feeling that something bad may happen
the feeling that something matters to you
a feeling of wanting to know more

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a parent watching a child, then move to a doctor reading results and to a rule that touches everyone.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从母亲望着孩子开始，再走到医生看检查单与涉及每个人的规定。

normal.en: Con- is together and cern is to sift, so concern is what your mind keeps sifting over.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，cern 是筛，concern 就是心里反复筛检的那件事。

normal.en: Concern as a noun is the worry; concern as a verb is what causes it.
normal.cn: concern 作名词是担忧，作动词则是引起担忧的东西。

normal.en: As far as I am concerned means as far as this touches me.
normal.cn: 「as far as I am concerned」意为就触及我的范围而言。

normal.en: A going concern is a business that is still running.
normal.cn: a going concern 就是仍在运转的企业。

normal.en: Concerned parents ask questions; unconcerned ones do not.
normal.cn: 关心的父母会追问，漠不关心的则不会。

abstract.en: Picture a mother at the school gate watching one small back.
abstract.cn: 想象母亲在校门口望着一个小小的背影。

abstract.en: Picture a finger tracing a line of test results.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指沿着一行检查结果划过去。

abstract.en: Picture a circle drawn around everyone in a room.
abstract.cn: 想象一个圆圈把屋里每个人都圈了进去。

examples.en: There is real concern about the rising cost of housing.
examples.cn: 人们对住房成本上涨确有担忧。

examples.en: Her health concerns the whole family.
examples.cn: 她的健康让全家担忧。

examples.en: The new rules concern every member of staff.
examples.cn: 新规定涉及每一位员工。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 concern 记成 con（一起）加 cern（筛）：心里反复筛来筛去的那件事，就是担忧与关切。

root: 源自拉丁语 concernere（com 一起 + cernere 筛、判断），本义是把事物筛到一起加以分辨，后引申为涉及、关心与担忧。

sensesIntro.en: From something sifted into your view, to the worry it causes, and finally to the fact that it affects you.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被筛进你视野的事，到它引起的担忧，最后到它确实影响到你。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a mother at the school gate, her eyes following one small figure.
core.cn: 核心意象：母亲站在校门口，目光追着一个小小的身影。

branches.en: The noun sense of worry is the most common in daily speech.
branches.cn: 名词的担忧义是日常口语中最常见的。

branches.en: The verb can point at the cause of worry rather than the feeling.
branches.cn: 动词可以指向担忧的起因，而非感受本身。

branches.en: Involvement is the oldest layer, still visible in concerning.
branches.cn: 关涉是最古老的一层，仍留在 concerning 里。

branches.en: Feeling and cause are two ends of one relation.
branches.cn: 感受与起因是同一关系两端。

branches.en: What touches you can worry you, and what worries you clearly touches you.
branches.cn: 触及你的事可能让你担忧，让你担忧的事必然触及你。

intro.en: Concern is built on Latin com-, together, plus cernere, to sift, through the French form concerner.
intro.cn: concern 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 cernere（筛）构成，经法语 concerner 进入英语。

latinIntro.en: The Latin sift base cern- also gives discern, certain and discriminate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的筛分词基 cern- 还给出 discern、certain 与 discriminate。

items.example: He looked at the meter concernedly.

items.exampleCN: 她似乎对延误毫不在意。

items.example: The concernment of the issue is clear.

definition_zh: 音乐会；演奏会；一致；协作
definition_en: a public performance of music, or agreement between people acting together
core_image: 整个乐团在指挥抬手的一瞬同时吸气
scene: 大厅的灯暗下来，第一声小提琴响起。The concert began with a single note from the violin.
sceneCN: 这里 concert 指「音乐会」（第 1 个义项：公开的音乐演出）；句意是音乐会以小提琴的一个单音开始。

pos.zh: 音乐会；演奏会；一致；协作

senses.title: A music performance
senses.definition: a public performance of music given by one or more musicians
senses.definitionCN: 由一位或多位音乐家进行的公开音乐演出
senses.example: The concert lasted two hours.
senses.exampleCN: 这场音乐会持续了两个小时。
senses.why: Many players must sound as one, so the event is named for their agreement.
senses.whyCN: 许多演奏者必须听起来像一个，所以这场活动以他们的和谐命名。

senses.title: Acting together
senses.definition: agreement or combined action between people or groups
senses.definitionCN: 人或团体之间的一致或联合行动
senses.example: The two groups acted in concert.
senses.exampleCN: 两个团体协同行动。
senses.why: The older sense is harmony, and harmony between people is also concert.
senses.whyCN: 更古老的意思是和谐，而人与人之间的和谐也是 concert。

intro.en: Concert comes from Italian concerto, agreement or harmony, and first named musicians playing as one.
intro.cn: concert 来自意大利语 concerto（一致、和谐），最初指乐手们如同一人地演奏。

items.en: Concertare meant to strive or to work together.
items.cn: concertare 意为共同努力或相互竞争。

items.en: Concerto named voices or instruments sounding in harmony.
items.cn: concerto 指人声或乐器和谐地响起。

items.en: A concerto also became a piece for soloist and orchestra.
items.cn: concerto 也成为一种独奏与乐队合作的作品。

items.en: French concert named a public musical gathering.
items.cn: 法语 concert 指公开的音乐聚会。

items.en: English concert took both the musical and the agreement senses.
items.cn: 英语 concert 同时接纳了音乐与一致两种含义。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to concert, and the meaning group names other words for a musical show.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 concert 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示音乐演出的词。

entries.definition: a small group of old instruments
an act of playing music for an audience
a small concert by one performer

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with an orchestra breathing together, then move to people acting as one.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从整个乐团一起吸气开始，再走到人们如同一人地行动。

normal.en: Con- is together and cert comes from a word for striving, so concert is many efforts made one.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，cert 源自表示努力的古词，concert 就是许多努力合成一个。

normal.en: In a concert, a hundred players breathe at the same moment.
normal.cn: 在音乐会上，上百名演奏者会在同一瞬间吸气。

normal.en: In concert with means working in harmony with others.
normal.cn: in concert with 意为与他人和谐协作。

normal.en: A rock concert and a symphony concert share the same name.
normal.cn: 摇滚音乐会与交响音乐会共用同一个名字。

normal.en: Concerto and concert are cousins, both from the idea of harmony.
normal.cn: concerto 与 concert 是表亲，都来自和谐这个意思。

abstract.en: Picture a conductor's hand lifting a whole orchestra at once.
abstract.cn: 想象指挥的手一下把整个乐团提起来。

abstract.en: Picture many strings vibrating into one warm sound.
abstract.cn: 想象许多琴弦振动成一个温暖的声音。

abstract.en: Picture two teams rowing in the same rhythm.
abstract.cn: 想象两支队伍按同一节奏划桨。

examples.en: We went to a concert in the park last night.
examples.cn: 昨晚我们去公园听了一场音乐会。

examples.en: The two countries acted in concert to protect the river.
examples.cn: 两国协作保护这条河。

examples.en: The concert hall was full an hour early.
examples.cn: 音乐厅提前一小时就坐满了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 concert 记成 con（一起）加 cert（确定）：大家把声音确定在同一个调上，就是音乐会，也是一致协作。

root: 源自意大利语 concerto（一致、和谐），上溯拉丁语 concertare（共同努力），本义是声音和谐一致，后指音乐会与协同行动。

sensesIntro.en: From many instruments sounding as one, to many people acting as one.
sensesIntro.cn: 从许多乐器发出同一个声音，到许多人如同一人地行动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a whole orchestra drawing breath together as the conductor lifts a hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：指挥抬手的一瞬，整个乐团一起吸气。

branches.en: The musical event is the everyday sense of concert.
branches.cn: 音乐活动是 concert 的日常义项。

branches.en: The agreement sense survives in the phrase in concert.
branches.cn: 一致义项保留在 in concert 这个短语中。

branches.en: A concert is public, so it gathers players and listeners.
branches.cn: 音乐会面向公众，因此聚起演奏者与听众。

branches.en: Joint action is harmony applied to work rather than music.
branches.cn: 联合行动是把和谐用于工作而非音乐。

branches.en: Both senses depend on many parts keeping one time.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖许多部分守住同一个节拍。

intro.en: Concert is built on Latin com-, together, plus certare, to strive, through the Italian form concerto.
intro.cn: concert 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 certare（努力）构成，经意大利语 concerto 进入英语。

latinIntro.en: The striving base cert- also appears in certain and certify, where it means settled.
latinIntro.cn: 表示努力的词基 cert- 也出现在 certain 与 certify 中，那里意为确定。

items.example: The band plays thirty concerts a year.

items.example: They made a concerted effort to save water.
items.exampleCN: 他们共同努力节约用水。

items.meaning: the leading violinist of an orchestra
a person who often attends concerts

items.example: She concertizes across Europe each summer.

items.meaning: a small box instrument with bellows

items.exampleCN: 他在炉火旁拉六角手风琴。

items.meaning: a piece for soloist and orchestra

items.exampleCN: 那首钢琴协奏曲是全场亮点。

definition_zh: n. 协奏曲
definition_en: a piece of music for one solo instrument and orchestra
core_image: 钢琴独奏与乐队在舞台上一问一答
scene: 钢琴协奏曲里，独奏与乐队互相应答。In the piano concerto the soloist answers the orchestra.

senses.title: A work for soloist and orchestra

senses.definitionCN: 独奏乐器与乐队相互映衬的乐曲
senses.example: The concerto opens with a quiet piano.
senses.exampleCN: 这首协奏曲以轻柔的钢琴开场。
senses.why: Italian concertare means to agree together.
senses.whyCN: 意大利语 concertare 意为协调一致。

senses.title: The older concerto grosso
senses.definition: an older form contrasting a small group with the full orchestra
senses.definitionCN: 以小组乐器与大乐队对照的旧形式
senses.example: The concerto grosso uses a group of soloists.
senses.exampleCN: 大协奏曲使用一组独奏者。
senses.why: Music history keeps this older sense.
senses.whyCN: 音乐史保留这一旧义。

intro.en: Concerto comes from Italian words for working in harmony.
intro.cn: concerto 源自意大利语「协调一致」的说法。

items.en: Certare means to strive or settle.

items.en: Italian named the new instrumental form.

items.en: English adopted concerto for the work.

items.en: It now fills concert halls worldwide.

note.en: The look-alike group shares the concert- shape; the near-meaning group names orchestral forms.

entries.definition: A work for one or two players.

normalIntro.cn: concerto 是一个演奏者与一群人的对话。

abstract.en: A lamp beside a whole orchestra.

certare 促成 concert 与 certain。

definition_zh: 让步；妥协；特许权；优惠
definition_en: something you allow in order to end an argument, or a special right given to someone
core_image: 守门人把栏杆抬起一半，让对方先过去
scene: 谈判桌上，双方各自放下一个条件。Each side made a concession before the deal was signed.
sceneCN: 这里 concession 指「让步」（第 1 个义项：为达成协议而让出的一点）；句意是签约前每一方都作了一项让步。

senses.title: A give in an argument
senses.definition: something you agree to give up in order to reach agreement
senses.definitionCN: 为达成协议而同意放弃的东西
senses.example: The union won a small concession on pay.
senses.exampleCN: 工会争取到了薪酬上的一点让步。
senses.why: One side lifts the barrier a little so the other can move.
senses.whyCN: 一方把栏杆抬起一点，好让另一方通过。

senses.title: A special right
senses.definition: the right to sell or use something, often given by a government
senses.definitionCN: 通常由政府授予的销售或使用某物的权利
senses.example: The company holds the mining concession.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司持有采矿特许权。
senses.why: A right granted is also a kind of thing yielded by the stronger side.
senses.whyCN: 被授予的权利，也是强者让出的一种东西。

senses.title: A lower price
senses.definition: a reduced price for students, children or old people
senses.definitionCN: 为学生、儿童或老人提供的减价
senses.example: Students get a concession on tickets.
senses.exampleCN: 学生买票可以享受优惠。
senses.why: The full price is lowered, as if part of the cost were given away.
senses.whyCN: 全价被降低，就像把部分费用让了出去。

intro.en: Concession comes from Latin concessio, a granting, from concedere, to give way or allow.
intro.cn: concession 来自拉丁语 concessio（准许），源自动词 concedere（让路、允许）。

items.en: Cedere meant to go or to yield ground.
items.cn: cedere 意为走或让出地盘。

items.en: Concedere meant to allow or to grant a request.
items.cn: concedere 意为允许或应允请求。

items.en: Concessio named the act of granting something.
items.cn: concessio 指给予某物的行为。

items.en: Old French concession kept the legal sense of a granted right.
items.cn: 古法语 concession 保留了授予权利的法律含义。

items.en: English concession first meant a thing granted or allowed.
items.cn: 英语 concession 最初指被授予或允许的东西。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to concession, and the meaning group names other words for yielding or privilege.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 concession 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示让出与特权的词。

entries.definition: a line of people moving in order
a statement that you have done wrong
a deal in which each side gives up something
a special right given to a person or group

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a barrier lifted halfway, then move to granted rights and to cheaper tickets.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从抬到一半的栏杆开始，再走到授予的权利与更便宜的票。

normal.en: Concession is the noun of concede, so it is the thing you let go.
normal.cn: concession 是 concede 的名词，所以它就是被你放手的东西。

normal.en: A concession stand sells snacks inside the barrier.
normal.cn: concession stand 就是在栏杆内卖零食的小摊。

normal.en: A mining concession is a right dug out of the ground.
normal.cn: 采矿特许权是从地里挖出来的一项权利。

normal.en: A student concession is a price that steps back for you.
normal.cn: 学生优惠是一张为你后退的价格。

normal.en: Concessive clauses begin with words like although, which also give way.
normal.cn: 让步从句以 although 这类词开头，它们也在让出立场。

abstract.en: Picture a gatekeeper lifting the bar just enough for one person.
abstract.cn: 想象守门人把栏杆抬到刚够一个人通过。

abstract.en: Picture a hand sliding a signed permit across a desk.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把签好的许可证推过桌面。

abstract.en: Picture a ticket stamped a little cheaper.
abstract.cn: 想象一张票被盖上便宜一些的章。

examples.en: The offer included several concessions on working hours.
examples.cn: 这份提议在工作时间上包含了几项让步。

examples.en: The firm won the oil concession for twenty years.
examples.cn: 这家公司赢得了二十年的石油开采特许权。

examples.en: Children over six must pay the full fare, without concession.
examples.cn: 六岁以上儿童须付全价，没有优惠。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 concession 记成 con（一起）加 cess（走）加 ion：从自己的立场上走出去一步，就是让步。

root: 源自拉丁语 concedere（com 一起 + cedere 走、让）的名词 concessio，本义是让路、准许，后指让步、特许权与优惠。

sensesIntro.en: From a small step back in an argument, to a right granted, and finally to a price lowered.
sensesIntro.cn: 从争论中后退一小步，到被授予的权利，最后到被降低的价格。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gatekeeper raising the bar halfway so the other side can pass.
core.cn: 核心意象：守门人把栏杆抬起一半，让对方先过去。

branches.en: A give in an argument is the common everyday sense.
branches.cn: 争论中的让步是常见的日常义项。

branches.en: A granted right turns the give into a legal object.
branches.cn: 被授予的权利把让步变成法律对象。

branches.en: A cheaper ticket is a concession in money.
branches.cn: 更便宜的票是金钱上的让步。

branches.en: Both senses describe something handed over by the stronger side.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述强者交出的东西。

branches.en: A right and a discount are both special treatment.

definition_zh: 断定；得出结论；结束；缔结
definition_en: to decide something after considering facts, or to bring something to an end
core_image: 一段长路走到尽头，回望时把整条路线看清
scene: 听完双方陈述，法官合上卷宗。The judge concluded that the evidence was weak.
sceneCN: 这里 conclude 指「断定」（第 1 个义项：根据事实作出判断）；句意是法官断定证据不足。

pos.zh: 断定；得出结论；结束；缔结

senses.title: Reach a judgment
senses.definition: to decide that something is true after thinking about the facts
senses.definitionCN: 在思考事实之后判定某事为真
senses.example: We concluded that the plan was too risky.
senses.exampleCN: 我们断定这个计划风险太大。
senses.why: When the evidence is all in, the mind shuts the case and settles.
senses.whyCN: 证据齐了，心就合上案卷，作出定论。

senses.title: Bring to an end
senses.definition: to finish an event, speech or piece of writing
senses.definitionCN: 结束一个活动、演讲或文章
senses.example: The meeting concluded at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 会议在中午结束。
senses.why: To close a matter is the same motion as closing a door.
senses.whyCN: 关闭一件事，和关上一扇门是同一个动作。

senses.title: Arrange a formal agreement
senses.definition: to complete a treaty, deal or agreement formally
senses.definitionCN: 正式完成条约、交易或协议
senses.example: The two countries concluded a trade agreement.
senses.exampleCN: 两国缔结了一项贸易协定。
senses.why: A deal is closed like a box, and once shut it is binding.
senses.whyCN: 交易像箱子一样被合上，一旦合上便有约束力。

intro.en: Conclude comes from Latin concludere, to shut up together, from com-, together, and claudere, to close.
intro.cn: conclude 来自拉丁语 concludere（一起关上），由 com-（一起）与 claudere（关闭）构成。

items.en: Claudere meant to close or to shut.
items.cn: claudere 意为关闭或合上。

items.en: Concludere meant to shut something in or to end it.
items.cn: concludere 意为把某物关起来或结束它。

items.en: Conclusio named a closing or a final inference.
items.cn: conclusio 指收尾或最终的推论。

items.en: Old French conclure meant to finish or to decide.
items.cn: 古法语 conclure 意为结束或决定。

items.en: English conclude took both the ending and the reasoning senses.
items.cn: 英语 conclude 同时接纳了结束与推理两种含义。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in shape to conclude, and the meaning group names other words for deciding or ending.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 conclude 形状相近的词，近义组列出其他表示断定与结束的词。

entries.definition: to have something as a part
to keep someone or something out
to bring something to an end
to reach an opinion from evidence

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a case file being closed, then move to a meeting ending and a treaty signed.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从合上案卷开始，再走到会议结束与条约签署。

normal.en: Con- is together and clude is to close, so conclude is to close everything up.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，clude 是关闭，conclude 就是把一切合上。

normal.en: Include and exclude also carry the same closing base.
normal.cn: include 与 exclude 也带着同一个关闭词基。

normal.en: A judge concludes when the evidence has been shut into one story.
normal.cn: 当证据被合进一个说法，法官就作出断定。

normal.en: A speech concludes with a last line, as a box closes with a lid.
normal.cn: 演讲以最后一句话收尾，如同箱子合上盖子。

normal.en: To conclude a deal is to close it so no one can add a term.
normal.cn: 达成交易就是把它合上，谁也不能再加条款。

abstract.en: Picture a thick folder closing on a desk.
abstract.cn: 想象一本厚卷宗在桌上合上。

abstract.en: Picture a road reaching its last stone.
abstract.cn: 想象一条路走到最后一块石头。

abstract.en: Picture two hands shaking as a door shuts behind them.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手相握，身后的门合上。

examples.en: The report concluded that the bridge was safe.
examples.cn: 报告断定这座桥是安全的。

examples.en: She concluded her talk with a short story.
examples.cn: 她用一个短故事结束了演讲。

examples.en: The two firms concluded a deal last week.
examples.cn: 两家公司上周达成了一笔交易。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 conclude 记成 con（一起）加 clude（关闭）：把事情一起合上，就是结束，也是作出结论。

root: 源自拉丁语 concludere（com 一起 + claudere 关闭），本义是合上、关起来，后引申为结束、缔结与得出结论。

sensesIntro.en: From shutting a case, to closing an event, and finally to sealing an agreement.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long road reaching its end, and the whole route seen at one glance.

branches.en: A formal deal is closed so that it stands.

branches.en: A speech and an argument both end when the speaker closes them.
branches.cn: 演讲与论证都在说话人合上时结束。

branches.cn: 结束与封定都意味着不再更改。

definition_zh: 结论；结尾；结束；缔结

senses.title: A judgment reached
senses.definition: a decision or opinion formed after considering the facts
senses.definitionCN: 在考虑事实之后形成的决定或看法
senses.example: Her conclusion was based on solid evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 她的结论建立在确凿证据之上。
senses.why: When the reasoning is closed, what remains is the conclusion.
senses.whyCN: 推理合上之后，留下来的就是结论。

senses.title: The end of something
senses.definition: the final part or end of an event or piece of writing
senses.definitionCN: 事件或文章的最后部分或终点
senses.example: The conclusion of the speech was moving.
senses.exampleCN: 演讲的结尾很动人。
senses.why: The last part closes the whole, just as a lid closes a box.
senses.whyCN: 最后一部分合上整体，正如盖子合上箱子。

senses.title: A formal agreement
senses.definition: the act of completing a treaty or deal formally
senses.definitionCN: 正式完成条约或交易的行为
senses.example: The conclusion of the peace treaty was welcomed.
senses.exampleCN: 和平条约的缔结受到欢迎。
senses.why: A deal is brought to its close, and that close is named the conclusion.
senses.whyCN: 交易被带到终点，而那个终点就叫 conclusion。

definition_en: to say strongly that something is wrong, or to sentence someone to punishment
core_image: 法官敲下木槌，当庭宣读判决
scene: 邻居们一致指责那家工厂污染了河水。The whole town condemned the factory for polluting the river.
sceneCN: 这里 condemn 指「谴责」（第 1 个义项：公开表示强烈反对）；句意是全镇人都谴责那家工厂污染河水。

pos.zh: 谴责；判刑；宣布不宜使用

senses.title: Name as wrong
senses.definition: to say in public that something is very wrong
senses.definitionCN: 公开表示某事非常错误
senses.example: The report condemned the use of child labour.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告谴责使用童工的行为。
senses.why: A public voice turns private dislike into a shared judgement.
senses.whyCN: 公开的声音把私人的反感变成共同的评判。

senses.title: Give a punishment
senses.definition: to order a legal punishment for someone
senses.definitionCN: 依法对某人作出惩罚判决
senses.example: The court condemned him to life in prison.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭判处他终身监禁。
senses.why: The court speaks with the weight of the whole community behind it.
senses.whyCN: 法庭说话时，背后是整个共同体的分量。

senses.title: Declare unsafe
senses.definition: to officially state that a building or object cannot be used
senses.definitionCN: 正式宣布某建筑或物品不能继续使用
senses.example: Inspectors condemned the old school building.
senses.exampleCN: 检查人员宣布这栋旧校舍不宜使用。
senses.why: A thing judged unfit is given a sentence just as a person is.
senses.whyCN: 被判定不合格的东西，也像人一样被判了刑。

intro.en: Condemn comes from Latin condemnare, to sentence or blame, built from com-, fully, and damnare, to harm or find guilty.
intro.cn: condemn 来自拉丁语 condemnare，意为判罪或指责，由 com-（彻底）与 damnare（损害、定罪）构成。

items.en: Damnare meant to find someone guilty and set a penalty.
items.cn: damnare 意为判定某人有罪并定下惩罚。

items.en: Condemnare added com- to make the judgement complete.
items.cn: condemnare 加上 com-，表示判决彻底成立。

items.en: Old French condemner carried the legal sense into common use.
items.cn: 古法语 condemner 把这个法律含义带入日常用法。

items.en: English condemn first meant to sentence a person in court.
items.cn: 英语 condemn 最初指在法庭上给人判刑。

items.en: It now also means to state strong moral disapproval in public.
items.cn: 如今它也指在公开场合表达强烈的道德反对。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that begin like condemn, and the meaning group names other ways of blaming or punishing.
note.cn: 形近组收的是与 condemn 词形相近的词，近义组列出其他指责或惩罚的说法。

to make something shorter or denser

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a court ruling, then move to a public protest and to a building marked unsafe.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从法庭判决开始，再走到公开抗议与被标记为危险的建筑。

normal.en: Con- means fully and damn- means to find guilty, so to condemn is to find fully guilty.
normal.cn: con- 表示彻底，damn- 表示定罪，所以 condemn 就是把罪名彻底定下。

normal.en: A judge condemns with a hammer, and a crowd condemns with a shout.
normal.cn: 法官用木槌定罪，人群用喊声谴责。

normal.en: Condemn and damn share the same core, which is why the word feels so heavy.
normal.cn: condemn 与 damn 共享同一个核心，所以这个词听起来很重。

normal.en: A condemned building is a building that has been sentenced.
normal.cn: 一栋被判定的建筑，就是一栋被宣判的建筑。

normal.en: Strong words condemn, and strong walls condemn too.
normal.cn: 强烈的话语在谴责，坚固的墙也可能被判为不能用。

abstract.en: Picture a wooden hammer falling on a desk.
abstract.cn: 想象一把木槌落在桌面上。

abstract.en: Picture a row of raised hands in a meeting.
abstract.cn: 想象会议上举起的一排手。

abstract.en: Picture a red sign nailed to a broken door.
abstract.cn: 想象一块红色告示钉在破损的门上。

examples.en: World leaders condemned the attack on the hospital.
examples.cn: 各国领导人谴责了针对医院的袭击。

examples.en: He was condemned to five years in prison.
examples.cn: 他被判处五年监禁。

examples.en: Engineers condemned the bridge after the flood.
examples.cn: 洪水过后，工程师宣布这座桥不能再用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 condemn 记成 con（彻底）加 demn（定罪）：把罪名彻底定下来，就是谴责与判刑。

root: 源自拉丁语 condemnare（com 彻底 + damnare 定罪），本义是判定有罪，后引申为公开谴责与宣布废弃。

sensesIntro.en: From a court sentence, to a public moral judgement, and finally to a building declared unfit.
sensesIntro.cn: 从法庭判决，到公开的道德评判，最后到被宣布不能使用的建筑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hammer falls and a whole crowd agrees with the verdict.
core.cn: 核心意象：木槌落下，全场人都认同这个判决。

branches.en: Condemnation by words needs an audience to become powerful.
branches.cn: 用言语谴责，需要听众才能产生力量。

branches.en: The legal sense gives the word its official weight.
branches.cn: 法律义项赋予这个词官方的分量。

branches.en: Buildings and objects can receive the same verdict.
branches.cn: 建筑和物品也会收到同样的判决。

branches.en: Both blame and punish by naming the act as wrong.
branches.cn: 谴责与判刑都先把行为认定为错误。

branches.en: A person and a place can both be sentenced out of use.
branches.cn: 人与地方都可能被判为不能再使用。

intro.en: Condemn is built on Latin com-, fully, plus damnare, to find guilty.
intro.cn: condemn 由拉丁语 com-（彻底）与 damnare（定罪）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base damn- also appears in damn and damage.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 damn- 也出现在 damn 与 damage 中。

items.meaning: to state that something is wrong
items.example: They condemn all forms of cheating.
items.exampleCN: 他们谴责一切形式的作弊。

items.example: The letter condemns the new policy.

items.exampleCN: 法官对欺诈行为定了罪。
她写了一份谴责性的报告。
这个计划遭到广泛谴责。
他发表了一篇谴责性的讲话。
这一行为显然该受谴责。

items.example: He damned the delay as careless.
items.exampleCN: 他斥责这次延误太粗心。
